high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "kaiagerber." The post features a person wearing a white nightgown with delicate lace details. The individual has long, wavy hair and is standing in what appears to be a bedroom setting. The background includes a bed with white bedding and a headboard. The person is posing with their arms raised above their head, showcasing the nightgown. The nightgown has a loose fit and features a lace trim around the neckline, sleeves, and hem. The fabric looks lightweight and sheer, giving it a soft and ethereal appearance.
